gloss: getting caught up in; collateral damage

definitions.gloss: getting caught up in; getting splashed; collateral damage
definitions.explanation: Suffering unintended negative consequences from someone else's actions or a situation one wasn't directly involved in.

examples.japanese: とばっちり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I got caught up in it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧、とばっちり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らった。
examples.english: My boss was in a bad mood and I got caught in the crossfire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とばっちり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{怒|おこ}られた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: I got scolded as collateral damage from my friends' fight.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Related to ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to fly) and ちる (to scatter) - originally referring to water splashing on a bystander. Now used metaphorically.

USAGE:
Describes being an innocent victim who suffers due to:
- Others' conflicts or mistakes
- Bad timing or being in the wrong place
- Chain reactions of negative events

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- とばっちり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ - to receive collateral damage
- とばっちり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らう - to get caught up in (stronger)
- とばっちり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ - collateral damage comes

REGISTER:
Casual, spoken Japanese. Often used humorously or with mild complaint.
